messages.subject: Warning translation CDS method
parts:
Hello,

We begin to use Distance software with a first study on blackbird. The parameters are Point transect with 3 manual intervals (25-100-200), radial distance, single observer and objects on 936 data. The analysis gives the next message :

** Warning: The number of adjustment parameters allowed has been reduced to 1 because of limited number of intervals. **

Could you explain us why this warning and its impact on the result ?

Thanks in advance.
Best regards,
Gilles Saulas
LPO Auvergne

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Warning translation CDS method
parts:
Gilles


I suspect that warning is arising when you are trying to fit a hazard rate model...  That family of detection functions has 2 parameters sigma and beta. Even if fitting a half-normal detection function, with a single parameter, you have only 3 "points of support" from the bins into which you combined your detection distances. If in addition to that, you are allowing adjustment terms (which add additional parameters to be estimated), you will soon have as many parameters in your detection function model as you have points of support (3 bins for your detection distances).  That will leave little information in the data with which to assess the goodness of fit of your model to your data.


In general, it is unwise to use many parameters (relative to your data support).
